(1) Admin list on inv_f44f20f2ac07 shows print/edit/del (count=1/1/1); admin detail shows print-hdr/edit-hdr/del-hdr (count=1/1/1). (2) Employee on the same invoice: list print=1, edit=0, del=0; detail print-hdr=1, edit-hdr=0, del-hdr=0 — role gating fully intact. critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/dialog.ts cleanly wraps Alert.alert with a Platform.OS==='web' fallback to window.confirm / window.alert. Both invoices/index.tsx and invoices/[id].tsx now import { confirm, notify } and await the async confirm() — good pattern, worth reusing for other Alert.alert call sites across the codebase (e.g. new.tsx save handler still uses Alert.alert per iteration_9).
